# LXMFy

> Python framework for building LXMF bots on the Reticulum Network. Handles the boilerplate: routing, storage, permissions, commands, cogs, signatures, delivery retries, and scheduled tasks. Requires Python 3.11+, rns, and lxmf.

## Docs

- [Quick Start](https://lxmfy.quad4.io/quick-start/): install, minimal bot, first deploy
- [Creating Bots](https://lxmfy.quad4.io/creating-bots/): commands, event handlers, cogs, storage, permissions, scheduled tasks, signatures, RRC
- [API Reference](https://lxmfy.quad4.io/api-reference/): configuration, LXMFBot methods, message fields, module reference
- [Full documentation](https://lxmfy.quad4.io/llms-full.txt): all English pages concatenated in one file

## Resources

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Quad4-Software/LXMFy): source, issues, releases
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/lxmfy/): pip install lxmfy
- [Reticulum](https://reticulum.network/): the network stack LXMF runs on
- [LXMF](https://github.com/Quad4-Software/LXMF): the messaging protocol library
